Text: Your House, and your fleets, believe conquest is the true way to glory. Without victory, there is nothing.
With improved scanning, planning and tactical tools, your House members are better able to prepare for battle, whether attacking or defending.
By focusing your stratagems around a single ship type, your captains have learned to wield these vessels as fine tools of war.
<pv>+15%</pv> Selected Vessel Type Strength when Leading Fleet
You lead a House of conquerors. Your vassals work hard to maintain a fittingly vast realm: both for the glory of your empire, and the fear of what hell you'd rain down if they failed.
The fury of your fleets is legendary - so much so that merely the threat of using them can be enough to win a battle.
- If successful, target ruler cannot join a combat against your house for <v>3</v> turns, unless called to arms by their direct overlord. (Cooldown: <v>4</v> turns)
Your House members understand that they all must pull together, and that you must guide the ship.
The resolve of your peacekeepers, and their ability to restrain their violent impulses, allows them to de-escalate unrest.
In your House members' hands, an interceptor is a deadly weapon: lightning quick, wielded with sharpened reflexes.
Your House has vowed to bring peace to your people. As long as you keep this promise, your vassals respect your rule all the more.

As respected leaders, your House can declare martial law in any system in your domain. Peacekeepers, shipwrights and defensive structures will be put on high alert, in the name of long-term peace and stability.
- Adds the <h>Martial Law</h> trait to a Target System in your domain (<h>3</h> turns)
Your House knows the value of money, commerce, and a tidy balance sheet.
Your administrators pay painstaking attention to tax record minutiae. Nothing slips their bureaucratic net.
By reframing taxation as the natural duty of respectful subjects, your House discourages dissent among your vassals. Your meticulous paperwork also makes it feel more official.
Your House's contacts among mercenaries and hirelings allows you to hire them at cut-rate prices.
Trade and commerce within your domain are booming. Some systems are now key trading hubs, emerging as well-known intergalactic bazaars.
Systems in your domain will have a chance to spawn the <h>Intergalactic Market</h> Installation.
- <pv>+1</pv> to base wealth generated in the system and all allied colonies within <h>6</h> starlanes of it
<helptext>The installation will spawn faster on systems where the ruler is part of your bloodline</helptext>
Your House has cultivated the admiration of your commoners, who are only too happy to support their benevolent overlords.
Your House has cultivated trust and adoration among your people. Your line is adored by commoner, merchant and craftsman alike.
Your line is adored by commoner, merchant and craftsman alike.
Nothing captures the people's imagination like restoring the cosmos to its original glory. Your House knows how to capitalise on that goodwill.
Your House has the ears of the people. You are experts in whispering just the right inflammatory comment into those ears.
Your House knows how to capitalise on popular unrest to gain a political foothold. When the people are angry, one can install a "saviour" with relative ease.
- The assignee establishes themselves, and your faction, as a legitimate ruler of a target system with over 40 unrest
Your House are deft at day-to-day diplomatic niceties: the  graceful thank-you. The delicate hand-off. The withering compliment.
With strong legal foundations and an efficient clerk culture, official requests can be swiftly passed along the legal chain.
Charging a ruler to avenge crimes no longer costs action points
Thanks to their sociable nature, your House members possess a certain allure and camaraderie. This makes them likeable, personable... and difficult to refuse.
Members of {House} are more likely to have the <h>Charming</h> trait
Your House has, over time, acquired a reputation as one of the more dignified and respectable noble families.
Your House knows that the true way to any ruler's heart is to bestow the one perfect, impossible gift that they desperately want but could never ask for.
Your House are considered not only the political rulers of your system, but its trusted stewards.
Your House has established a mourning tradition. On the death of the House head, their successor secludes themselves in a House shrine for meditation and internal preparation.
Heads of your House have <pv>+10</pv> to <h>Selected Skill</h> when the previous head dies
Your House members are loyal to their Head. The role has become a symbol of the House itself, no matter who currently occupies it.
Your home system is studded with bugs, feeds and surveillance scanners. It's said an ambassador cannot pick his nose without you knowing. An exaggeration - but one it is useful to encourage.
Your House's Officer corps works tirelessly to keep assignments running smoothly, and coordinate the efforts of all your House members.
House spies are assigned an accomplice as a matter of House policy, for operational support.
Your House is the centre of a vast surveillance network, stretching beyond the edge of your realm. A dossier for every House, and a plot for every dossier.
<h>Order Report</h> on a star system no longer requires a <h>Spy Network</h> to be active
By controlling who sees what critical information, your House lessens the chance your secrets will fall into the wrong hands.
House members are trained in the ways of poison, blade and strangulation - and to see all outsiders as potential prey.
For your spies, information gathering is like breathing. They are also trained to recognise, and exploit, any opportunity for espionage or sabotage.
<h>Order Report</h> on a star system no longer costs action points.
Your <h>Spy Network</h> will generate special opportunities more often.
Your House "encourages" vassals to pay an extra tax, for "insurance against piracy." Your pirate contacts are only too happy to help.
Randomly get Extra Credits from Assist Tax Collection
When spreading dissent, your House works with pirate bands to raid the target system, spreading chaos. This is not only effective, but often profitable.
Randomly get Extra Credits from Spread Dissent
Having trained and brawled with pirates, your House members know how to squeak through a fight by the skin of their teeth.
Your House admirals have studied pirate tactics, and know how to deliver a swift blow, undetected, to a vulnerable spot.
Your House's close contacts with pirate gangs allow you to organise ad-hoc raids on enemy systems.
- Use your pirate contacts to damage a Target System's economy, fleet, or infrastructure
Though far from true genetic engineering, your House genesmiths tinker your line to select for desired traits.
Members of {House} are more likely to have the <h>Intelligent</h> trait
Your House knows the value of pre-Collapse technology, and takes every opportunity to retrieve and study it.
Your House uses data-based educational techniques to help wards learn faster, better.
Your House doctors are second to none. They have access to cutting-edge medical techniques from ancient databases, and are driven by a desire to save life wherever possible.
Your House have painstakingly gathered the equipment and techniques needed to rebuild scientific knowledge. Each time you publish, your fame grows.
- Gain {Respect}{Respect} for presenting scientific findings to the galactic community
Your House engineers have mastered the use of interchangeable components, allowing your shipwrights to quickly adapt your fleet to new circumstances.
Your House has streamlined its supply of materials, parts and tools. The process of fleet repair now runs like clockwork.
Your messenger drones' improved speed and durability allow you to extend your will further across your realm, and ensure it is governed effectively.
Your House can not only refit fleets with ease, but can often spare enough starships to send entire squadrons to reinforce vassal systems.
- Gift up to 2 Military Strength worth of each type of vessel to the Target System's Ruling House's Fleet
Your House runs a sophisticated and dedicated engineering corps, capable of turning any dilapidated spacedock into a logistical powerhouse.
Systems in your domain will have a chance to spawn the <h>Specialized Hangar</h> Installation.
<helptext>The installation will spawn faster on systems where the ruler is part of your bloodline.</helptext>
